claim_one_line: THE ASSEMBLY CLASSIFICATION IS FALSE AS STATED: ALL SIX CANDIDATES ADMIT A 27-DIMENSIONAL ASSEMBLY. Scope (assembly) flags Theorem (classify) as owed -- 'its code is not deposited, so by this paper's own standard the theorem is an assertion ABOUT a computation ... The full six-group classification should be read as unverified.' This is that code. The six groups are constructed as the theorem describes (2T the 24 Hurwitz units, 2O the 48, 2I the 120 icosians, the rest permutation groups) and conjugacy classes, power maps and characters are COMPUTED by Dixon's algorithm at the least prime p > C(29,3) = 3654 with p = 1 mod 120, the lcm of the six exponents; no character value is transcribed. RESULT: a 27-dimensional assembly, in exactly the paper's sense -- a direct sum of non-trivial complex irreducibles of total dimension 27 carrying a non-degenerate invariant cubic form -- exists for ALL SIX, not only A4 and 2T. The decider is the BLOCK-SUM LEMMA: if W is IRREDUCIBLE with a non-zero invariant cubic then the trilinear form has ZERO radical (the radical is G-stable, so 0 or W, and W means f = 0), hence if 27 = sum m_i d_i over non-trivial irreducibles each carrying a cubic, the block-diagonal cubic is invariant with zero radical. Witnesses: A4, S4, 2T, 2O all have a 3-dimensional irreducible with an invariant cubic, so 9x3; A5 and 2I have a 4 and a 5, so 3x4 + 3x5. Checked independently on EXPLICIT MATRICES over Q: sum(x_i^3) on {sum x_i = 0} is S4-invariant over all 24 elements and 27 triples with radical 0, and 2O inherits it through 2O/{+-1} = S4; A5 on 5 points gives the 4 and on the six Sylow-5 subgroups gives the 5, each invariant over all 60 elements with radical 0, and 2I inherits both. WHY THE EARLIER REPAIR FAILED: Scope (assembly) repaired a false earlier version by excluding TRIVIAL summands and demanding non-degeneracy; the same failure mode survives one level up, since what the definition fails to control is MULTIPLICITY, not triviality. LOAD-BEARING: the next step needs the survivor set to be {A4, 2T} so that binariness isolates 2T, but 2O and 2I survive and BOTH ARE BINARY (Corollary onlybinary, verified here), so the failure is not absorbed downstream. WHAT DOES NOT BREAK: the paper's primary route to 2T is arithmetic, not this theorem -- the surjection pi_1(4_1) -> SL(2,F_3) = 2T, which B8076 item 6 verified exhaustively (48 surjections; 2I and A5 are NOT quotients over all 14400 and 3600 pairs). What is lost is a CORROBORATING argument that the entrance is not an assignment, not the entrance itself. THE REPAIR OWED: the definition must pin the cubic rather than require one to exist -- naturally, that (V,f) be the 27 of E6 with its Jordan determinant, equivalently that the assembly realise the group inside E6; that is a different computation and is registered as owed, not asserted. CONTROLS: closure and order for all six; sum of squared degrees = |G| and column orthogonality for all six tables; Lemma (quat) verified with the determinant filter it actually assumes; Corollary (onlybinary) verified; and the 3-dimensional icosahedral irreducibles carry NO invariant cubic, matching the classical invariant degrees 2, 6, 10 -- a fact this arc did not choose. SCOPE: refutes the theorem AS STATED under the paper's own definition; does not show no correct classification exists, and names the condition a correct one would need. Gate 5 untouched.
